explanation: Rechecking confirms that I has matching mixed partials 6e^(3x+2y)+6y, and II has matching mixed partials 8y−15x^2. They are realized by f=e^(3x+2y)+3xy^2 and f=4xy^2−5x^3y, respectively. III gives 18x^2y versus 6y^3, which cannot agree throughout an open set. Thus the revealed solution confirms I and II only.
